home.text1: in times of constant noise, we choose to offer creative silence: unique worlds designed to inspire, connect, and spark dreams.
home.text2: imagination is the ultimate refuge of freedom.

ednaldo.title: Ednaldo Pereira Mescladasso DX
ednaldo.string1: Remaster of the original collectathon Ednaldo Pereira: MESCLADASSO. Play as Ednaldo and Fleig, going through a plethra of different stages.
ednaldo.string2: In this game you'll be introduced to the successful EDNALDO PEREIRA. A human being so powerful few are able to fully grasp. The universe is in shambles due to the evildoings of the Dark Elite and you must stop them by using your powers!
ednaldo.string3: This collection also features a PC Port of the original EDNALDO PEREIRA: MOBILE! Adapted to be played with Keyboard and Controller! This is a completely different game and unique experience that has been adapted to perfection in this PC port.
ednaldo.string4: The friendly duo Ednaldo & Fleig are always up to saving the world with the evil doings of the Dark Elite! Ednaldo is a powerful all-knowing beast, while Fleig is his smart and fast companium! Together, they are unstoppable.

ednaldomobile.title: Ednaldo Pereira Mobile
ednaldomobile.string1: Ednaldo Mobile is a FREE captivating platform game inspired by platforming classics that offers an engaging and challenging gaming experience. Explore different stages filled with obstacles, enemies, and treasures to unlock. Overcome thrilling challenges, collect golden notes, and improve your skills while enjoying vibrant graphics and an exciting soundtrack with remixes of Ednaldo's classics.
ednaldomobile.string3: The game is currently undergoing maintenance @ Google Play. Please play at GX.Games at the moment!

artius.title: ARTIUS
artius.string1: ARTIUS is a momentum-driven 2D platformer bursting with vibrant creativity. When the envious Pivolo seizes control of the mystical ARTIUS book and imposes an oppressive art dictatorship, it’s up to you to restore freedom. Take charge of a group of artists, each wielding their own creative powers, and fight to save a world on the brink of losing its art forever!
artius.string2: The world of ARTIUS is full of colourful characters, which all have their own personal tales to tell and contribute to the game world.
artius.string4: Pivolo, envious of the protagonists’ artistic mastery, seizes control of the mystical ARTIUS book and enforces an art dictatorship, reshaping the world according to his rigid and oppressive vision. Under his rule, creativity is stifled, self-expression is outlawed, and once-vibrant landscapes become dull and lifeless. As the influence of Pivolo’s tyranny spreads, society begins to question the value of art itself, forgetting its power to inspire, heal, and bring people together. It falls upon the four heroes—each wielding their own unique creative abilities—to challenge this bleak new reality.
artius.string5: Inspired by Sonic Frontiers' Open Zone and Bomb Rush Cyberfunk’s world, the hub world is more interactive and immersive than typical platformers, allowing players to explore, customize structures, and engage creatively in this dynamic environment. Levels are linear and divided into acts, with character-exclusive stages to teach specific mechanics. These mechanics are later combined in “final acts’, where players seamlessly chain actions across characters for exhilarating gameplay sequences.
artius.string7: ARTIUS is currently seeking funding and publishing opportunities to reach its full potential. If you believe in the power of art and creativity in gaming, now is the time to help make ARTIUS a reality. Stay tuned—this adventure is coming soon, and with your support, it can shine even brighter!

about.title: About.
about.description: PVic Games was founded in July 2023, led by Pedro Victor Gonçalves, a developer with experience in the Sonic fan game community and later in the independent game scene, where he worked as a gameplay programmer on ANTONBLAST.
about.description2: The studio was created with the goal of developing original games with a strong artistic identity, focusing on projects that invite players to explore new worlds filled with imagination, culture, and personality.

pedro.name: Pedro Victor Gonçalves
pedro.role: Team Head, Game Designer, Lead Developer and Stage Designer
pedro.text: Pedro Victor Gonçalves is a passionate game designer with broad expertise across multiple areas of game development, specializing in game design and programming. Raised in southern Brazil, Pedro has spent years honing his craft on 2D, action-driven platformers. In 2023, he joined SUMMITSPHERE as a Gameplay Programmer for the acclaimed indie title ANTONBLAST. Later, he founded his own studio, PVic Games, where he developed popular Brazilian indie hits such as Ednaldo Pereira Mescladasso and Ednaldo Pereira Mobile. His most ambitious project to date is ARTIUS, a bold and expansive game that represents the culmination of his creative vision and development experience.

casanova.name: Gabriel Casanova
casanova.role: Game Producer, Developer and Narrative Designer
casanova.text: Gabriel Casanova is a game and web developer with an associate degree in Information Technology. He has collaborated with Pedro Victor Gonçalves since 2017 and joined PVic Games in 2024, where he developed the very website you're using now. In 2025, Gabriel took on the role of producer for ARTIUS, ensuring the project stays on schedule, within budget, and meets its quality goals. He manages team coordination and plays a vital role in translating the game designer’s vision into a tangible experience. Gabriel also serves as the narrative designer, crafting the game’s story and ensuring the lore remains cohesive, consistent, and immersive.

kevin.name: Kevin Macedo
kevin.text: Kevin is a game developer that got known for making horror-themed Sonic Fangames, with the incredibly popular ''Sonic.EXE PC Port''. With a pedigree in 2D platformer game development, he has collaborated with Pedro Victor Gonçalves for a long time, joining PVic Games in 2023 and being a programmer on Ednaldo Pereira Mescladasso DX. In 2024, he joined the ARTIUS project as a gameplay developer and in 2025 also took the role of stage designer.

pablo.name: Pablo Tavares
pablo.role: Concept Artist, Character/Marketing Artist and Animator
pablo.text: Pablo is a concept artist, key/marketing artist, and animator who has been collaborating with PVic Games since 2025 on the development of ARTIUS. He is also the creator of his own comic book series and character, The Existence of Folião. His distinctive artistic style and experience have been essential in shaping the game's bold, cartoon-inspired look and feel.

bredi.name: Bredi Amai
bredi.role: Stage Artist, Sprite Artist, and Animator
bredi.text: Bredi is a multidisciplinary artist and game developer. He is the creator of the Pizza Tower fangame Toadlegette Revolution and also contributed to the widely popular Pizza Tower project Sugary Spire. In 2025, he joined PVic Games as a stage artist, sprite artist, and animator, working closely with Pedro Victor Gonçalves on the game’s art direction to help maintain a consistent and high-quality visual style.

vivi.name: ViviJackalope
vivi.text: ViviJackalope has been collaborating with PVic Games since 2023, beginning with her work as an artist on Ednaldo Pereira: Mescladasso DX. Throughout the development of ARTIUS, she has provided valuable sprite work, props, and visual assets, helping bring the game’s world to life.

speed.name: SpeedVGM
speed.text: SpeedVGM is a musician, artist, animator, and indie game developer. With several albums and project contributions under his belt, he has been a long-time musical collaborator of Pedro Victor Gonçalves, working together across both indie games and fangame projects. In ARTIUS, he composed numerous themes and tracks, collaborating closely with SaGa! to define the game’s musical identity.

saga.name: SaGa!
saga.text: SaGa! is a music arranger, performer, and producer. Since 2025, he has been a frequent collaborator at PVic Games, working alongside SpeedVGM on the soundtrack for ARTIUS. Together, they help shape the game’s rich and dynamic musical identity.

balibali.name: Bánhegyi ''Balibali'' Balázs
balibali.text: A familiar name in the 2D Sonic community, Balibali is a dedicated Level Designer recognized for his work on acclaimed fan projects, including being the main level designer for the fangame Sonic Megamix Mania. His professional relationship with Pedro Victor Gonçalves deepened thanks to the latter's help on the translation of Sonic Megamix Mania. Balibali is now bringing his extensive experience in creating compelling and engaging game environments to PVic Games, having joined the team in late 2025.
